title: Run event
description: One line of events.jsonl. Append-only. Arrays and images live in their own files and are referenced under artifacts.

run.description: Run id, same as the run folder name.

step.description: Plan step id, or null for run-level events.

ts.description: UTC, ISO 8601 with milliseconds, from the facade's clock for every machine.

mono_ns.description: Monotonic clock, for durations within one process.

op.description: Operation name from the machine's manifest.

path.description: Relative to the run folder, forward slashes.
